analysis: The PR changes docs/architecture/inference.md only. The visible patch bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one failure-modes table row near head line 3552: a provider crash loop on a pre-release macOS 27.2 build, caused by SDK 27.2 Date comparisons. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the row's cause and remediation text are not fully visible. The supplied base text covers the rest of the file, including cluster mode choice, Flint, Qwen batching, load-memory gating, an add-on hold row and the code map. These sections are unchanged context and match the retained threat model. I found no source, protocol, key, attestation, cache-storage, authorization or configuration change. The documentation does not claim new security controls or weaken the documented ones. Threats T-041 (prefix cache), TB-011 (App Attest authorization) and TB-012 (add-on hold) are referenced only by unchanged text, so no threat-model update is needed. The remaining uncertainty is the truncated added row. If it recommends operator actions such as disabling checks or changing security settings, a later pass should confirm it does not weaken a trust boundary. Nothing visible suggests that, and a crash loop is an availability symptom (compare T-043 watchdog and rollback), not a new attack surface.
